title: Portfolio Prioritization Simulator: combining RICE with cost/latency elasticity and OKR heatmaps
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Problem: PMs currently apply RICE or bespoke heuristics to prioritize roadmap items, but we lack an interactive way to test portfolio-level outcomes under realistic cost/latency elasticity assumptions and OKR alignment constraints. This causes last-mile rework when engineering constraints or cost forecasts change.

Proposal: Build a lightweight Portfolio Prioritization Simulator (web prototype + CSV API) that: 1) accepts a list of candidate initiatives with R/I/C/E inputs plus estimated latency and token-cost delta; 2) overlays model-level/route-level cost and latency elasticity curves (e.g., how batching, KV cache, quantization change per-token cost under scale); 3) computes portfolio-level throughput/latency/cost forecasts and OKR attainment probability; 4) exposes scenario compare, sensitivity analysis, and top-K best-effort tradeoffs (maximize RICE under cost/latency caps or maximize OKR coverage under budget).

Goals: 1) Reduce prioritization churn by exposing realistic operational constraints; 2) Provide quantifiable tradeoffs for roadmap planning conversations (PM<>Eng<>Finance); 3) Seed product requirements for console features (optimizer suggestions) and data for Dedicated capacity recommendations.

Scope (MVP): - UI: minimal simulator canvas to upload CSV or pick current backlog items - Engine: deterministic optimizer that solves knapsack-like selection under resource caps with configurable metrics weighting - Models: two preset elasticity profiles (conservative, aggressive) and ability to plug custom curves - Outputs: ranked portfolio, cost/latency forecast time-series, OKR heatmap, and exportable scenario diff report.

Open questions / trade-offs: - Accuracy vs speed: we can run an exact integer optimization (higher accuracy) or a fast heuristic (better for interactive). Recommend heuristic for MVP and schedule exact solver for later. - Inputs fidelity: do we require per-route token distribution? MVP will accept coarse estimates and offer guidance to improve later. - Ownership: PM leads product design; ENG will provide baseline cost/latency curves (needs telemetry). Finance input required for budget constraints.

Success criteria (MVP): - PMs can create and compare 3 scenarios in <10 minutes - Simulator results used in at least 2 roadmap decisions during Q2 planning - Post-launch survey: >= 70% of reviewers report improved confidence in prioritization decisions

Links / artifacts: PRD (draft): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PM/Portfolio+Prioritization+Simulator, Prototype Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/prioritization-sim, Telemetry dashboard for cost/latency baselines: https://dashboards.redwood.com/d/cost-latency/baselines
